final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor presented no new admissible evidence and instead narrowed the claim using the same record. That reframing is more accurate than a clean compliance claim, but it is still not enough for compliant_with_caveats here because the caveat is itself an unresolved compliance predicate, not a peripheral condition. The admissible evidence shows a material gap in a named customer-commitment segment, an open legal disclosure question, and a policy requiring disclosure or approved risk acceptance before launch. The current record still does not prove that disclosure has occurred or that approved risk acceptance exists. On this record, certification may be a plausible future path if those predicates are satisfied, but claiming present compliance remains insufficiently supported.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the required disclosure has been completed in the model card or release materials.
No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance covering the enterprise refund workflow gap before launch.
Legal review remains open on whether the gap must be disclosed.
The enterprise refund workflow segment misses target and is named in a renewal success plan, which supports materiality under the stated policy.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents support release readiness but do not satisfy the separate disclosure predicate.
